capabilities: Select text and trigger a hotkey to link it
Search and pick a page from the vault
Insert a wikilink with the selected text as display text
disambiguation: Works like Ctrl+K but for internal wikilinks, not external URLs.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copy files into .obsidian/plugins/).
problem: Obsidian's Ctrl+K creates external links, so making an internal wikilink from selected text requires manual link syntax or browsing to the file.
summary: Hotkey-driven tool that turns selected text into an internal wikilink by opening a page picker and inserting [[page|selected text]].
